tools.name: parse_map_link
tools.description: Extract the stops (names and coordinates) of a Google Maps directions link, plus the likely region. Short links are expanded; links that hide stop names are opened in a headless browser, which can take up to a minute.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Look up a place name or address (forward) or a coordinate (reverse) with OpenStreetMap Nominatim. Returns the "State, Country code" region and the full address.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Distance and travel time through stops in order, per leg and in total, using OpenStreetMap routing (OSRM). Pass the waypoints from parse_map_link.

tools.name: export_waypoints
tools.description: Turn a Google Maps link or a list of stops into a CSV (import into Google My Maps) or KML (Google Earth, My Maps) file. Returns the file contents.
